Emily Chen: Partner (EdgeWave) wants bandwidth-based usage buckets to map to our marketplace SKUs + an invoice preview for entitlements lifecycle. Who owns SKU mapping + reconciliation playbook? :thinking:

Raj Patel: I can take mapping. Quick q — are buckets static (L/M/H) or dynamic percentiles?

Sofia Martinez: They're asking fixed thresholds (0-10GB, 10-100GB, >100GB). Need to confirm exact bytes thresholds and timezone for period cut.

Dillon Park: For reconciliation, propose a shadow run: ingest partner events into staging, run our aggregator, then compare partner.reported_units vs marketplace.billable_units daily.

Emily Chen: Partner also wants an "invoice preview" artifact for each entitlement so SI can validate before public billing. Can we produce that?

Ava (Marketing): We need final numbers + announcement wording 10 business days before joint announcement. Legal will also need copy.

Raj Patel: Plan sketch: 1) mapping table in partner namespace 2) 7-day shadow run 3) daily reconciliation CSV with deltas 4) delta alerting if >0.5% by volume

Sofia Martinez: SQL snippet I used previously for bandwidth bucketing (adaptable):
```sql
SELECT entitlement_id,
  SUM(bytes) AS total_bytes,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(bytes) <= 10 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'L1'
    WHEN SUM(bytes) <= 100 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 THEN 'L2'
    ELSE 'L3' END AS bandwidth_bucket
FROM partner_usage
WHERE ts >= '{{start}}' AND ts < '{{end}}'
GROUP BY entitlement_id;
```

Dillon Park: Add a rolling 24h compare and a 7-day aggregate to catch bursty traffic. Tolerance 0.5% absolute on units, 1% on dollar value. If exceeded, auto-open partner ops ticket.

ops-bot: Created issue MP-241: "EdgeWave bandwidth SKU mapping shadow run" assigned to Raj Patel.

Emily Chen: Next steps — Raj to deliver mapping + sample invoice CSV by Tue EOD, Sofia to spin up shadow pipeline in staging, Dillon to add delta monitor, Ava to draft announcement timeline and legal checklist. I'll compile partner-facing kickoff doc.

Ava (Marketing): I need two sample invoice previews (one low-volume, one high-volume) and the CSV schema. Also want suggested consumer-facing phrasing for the marketplace listing.

Raj Patel: Sample invoice CSV format: entitlement_id, sku, period_start, period_end, units, unit_price_cents, total_amount_cents. I'll attach sample rows to MP-241 when ready.

Sofia Martinez: Reminder — align period cutoff to partner timezone (EdgeWave set to UTC by default). Confirm with partner.

Emily Chen: Thanks — once we have sample CSV and shadow deltas <0.5% for 7 days, we'll sign off for announcement. Tagging partner POC after Tuesday. :thumbsup:

Ava (Marketing): I'll slot the announcement draft for review on Wed. If legal signs off earlier we can move faster.

Raj Patel: On it. Will post the mapping table + a quick validation script (Python) in the issue thread.

Dillon Park: Also recommend a backstop fallback: if marketplace ingestion lags >1 hour, route billing to partner-reported values until reconciled. Document this in runbook.

Emily Chen: Good call. I'll add fallback policy to the kickoff doc.

Ava (Marketing): FYI — marketing prefers we avoid technical bucket names in consumer messaging; suggest using "Starter / Growth / Enterprise" instead of L1/L2/L3.

Sofia Martinez: Noted. We'll keep internal names L1/L2/L3 for engineering and map to marketing labels in the CSV.

Emily Chen: Closing loop: Raj/Sofia/Dillon to sync on MP-241 updates by Tue 11:00 PT, Ava drafts announcement copy by Wed 15:00 PT. ops-bot please keep ticket open until post-announcement reconciliation completes.

ops-bot: MP-241 status -> open, watchers: Emily Chen, Raj Patel, Sofia Martinez, Dillon Park, Ava (Marketing).
